title: West Pikeland votes to sell SALT Performing Arts' home
summary: Supervisors voted 3-2 to put the township building at 1645 Art School Rd. up for bid to help fund a new police facility, a year after the youth theater company finished about $400,000 in renovations there. Bidders could keep SALT's lease or ask to end it.

title: Chester County Hospital opens an outpatient lactation center
summary: Penn Medicine Chester County Hospital has opened a center where new parents can book one-on-one sessions with lactation consultants after they go home with their baby.

title: Stove & Tap wins People's Choice at the rescheduled Chili Cook-Off
summary: Thousands turned out downtown on Oct. 18 for the weather-delayed F4 Chili Cook-Off, where Ryan's Pub took the restaurant title and about 800 pounds of leftover chili went to local nonprofits.

title: West Chester Refillery Station opens on East Street Road
summary: A refill shop selling household staples in bulk for customers' own containers has opened at 54 E. Street Rd., per the Inquirer's Chester County roundup.

title: Downingtown schools superintendent to step down after next year
summary: Downingtown Area School District Superintendent Robert O'Donnell, in the job since July 2022, told the school board he will leave at the end of the 2026-27 school year.

title: West Chester Christmas Parade recruits walking marshals for the first time
summary: The Greater West Chester Chamber is adding about 30 marshals who will march inside the Dec. 4 parade alongside floats and bands, on top of the usual 70 sidewalk volunteers. The parade and tree lighting open six weekends of downtown holiday lights.

title: DEP sets Nov. 19 community meeting on the Bishop Tube cleanup
summary: State environmental regulators will present findings from soil and groundwater investigations at the contaminated East Whiteland site and outline next steps for the cleanup, 6-8 p.m. at General Wayne Elementary in Malvern.
loc: Bishop Tube site, East Whiteland Township

title: Turks Head Wines adds a restaurant to its West Chester tasting room
summary: The California-focused winery at 120 N. Church St. began serving food this month and brought on chef Dave McDonald, formerly of Helm BYOB.

title: West Chester's Centinel Spine files to go public on the NYSE
summary: The artificial spinal disc maker filed with the SEC on Oct. 7 to list under the ticker CNTL, which would make it the region's first life sciences IPO since late 2024. The 138-employee company turned a profit in the first half of 2026.

title: Residents and Adrian Martinez finish 70 feet of murals at Pinckney Hill Commons
summary: A two-year collaboration led by the Downingtown painter, with dozens of residents and children adding brushwork and handprints, produced three indoor murals at the 51-unit affordable housing community on the Melton Center grounds.
